dashboard.welcome_msg: Welcome to the AgriProcure portal. View your scheduled grain drop-off slots, register crop details, and track your queue tokens.
dashboard.instr_1: Please arrive 15 minutes prior to slot opening.
dashboard.instr_2: Carry valid Aadhaar Card or Farmer Registration receipt.
dashboard.instr_3: Produce this screen (Token {{token}}) at the center check-in gate.
dashboard.mod_closed: Modification closed — less than {{hours}} hours before slot, or token already called.
dashboard.no_appt_desc: Schedule your upcoming drop-off slot at the nearest procurement depot. Locking a slot guarantees MSP payments and prevents long queues.
dashboard.cancel_desc: Are you sure you want to cancel token {{token}}? This action cannot be undone and you will lose your spot in the queue.
dashboard.no_msp_rates: No active MSP rates published yet.

booking.location_desc: AgriProcure helps direct you to nearby government depots. Select your location parameters to retrieve live depot counts.
booking.no_centres: No open procurement centres found in {{block}}.
booking.no_crops: No crop products offered at this center.
booking.no_slots: No open scheduling calendar dates available.
booking.confirmed_desc: Your queue token receipt has been generated successfully. Show this token code at the center entrance.
booking.use_gps_desc: Auto-detect nearest depots instantly with road distance calculation.
booking.select_manual_desc: Browse depots through State, District, and Block administrative filters.
booking.find_nearest_desc: Allow device location access to instantly find approved procurement centres closest to you.
booking.nearest_depots_subtitle: Sorted by computed road proximity to your device GPS coordinates
booking.no_centres_gps_desc: We could not find any active procurement centres with registered coordinates near your device location.
booking.depot_guidelines_desc: Depot capacities are capped per day for quality assurance. Choose a centre nearest to your transport route, then choose your harvest crop on the next step.
booking.err_valid_weight: Please enter a valid weight quantity.
booking.err_max_limit: Quantity exceeds the center's maximum limit of {{max}} kg for this crop.

reschedule.title: Reschedule Appointment
reschedule.subtitle: Select a new date for {{crop}}
reschedule.no_dates: No alternative dates available at this centre.

auth.farmer_desc: Book procurement slots, view MSP rates, and track your queue ticket live.
auth.staff_desc: Manage daily grain intake, clear farmer queues, and issue payments.
auth.admin_desc: System oversight, reports, and regional center management console.
auth.invalid_mobile: Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number
auth.reg_submitted_staff: Your request to register {{centre}} is awaiting admin approval. You will be able to log in once approved.

landing.hero_title: Book your crop sale, skip the wait
landing.hero_subtitle: Book a slot, get a token, and track your place in line right from your phone.
landing.step_2: Choose your district and block, pick a nearby centre
landing.step_3: Book a date and get your token
landing.step_4: Track your live queue position from your phone
landing.step_5: Complete procurement and track your payment status
landing.benefit_1: No more waiting in line all day
landing.staff_desc: AgriProcure also provides tools for centre staff and admins to manage daily grain intake and farmer queues.
landing.token_section_desc: Every farmer receives a unique procurement token. Monitor your live queue position from your phone, get notified when your turn approaches, and receive instant confirmation once payment is credited. No more uncertainty or waiting all day.
